messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["bear", "beetle"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A large heavily built brown bear-like quadruped shown in side view walking to the right. A glossy dark brown-black beetle-like exoskeleton covers the top of its head and its neck and shoulders like armor, with a distinct small beetle head bearing reddish eyes and tiny jointed gripping legs on top of the bear head between the ears. From that beetle head grow a very long curved forked horn arching up and back and a shorter pointed horn. A row of small dark oval openings runs along the side of the furry torso, and small segmented brown plates sit on the front of each lower leg.", "extra_limb_pieces": 2, "heads": 2, "parts": [{"looks_like": "bear", "part": "head", "where": "at the front of the body facing right, with muzzle, nose, eye and furry cheek"}, {"looks_like": "beetle", "part": "head", "where": "on top of the bear head between the ears, small dark with reddish eyes"}, {"looks_like": "beetle", "part": "horns", "where": "growing from the beetle head on top of the bear head, one very long curved horn arching up and back and one shorter pointed horn"}, {"looks_like": "bear", "part": "ears", "where": "on the sides of the bear head below the beetle, small rounded and furry"}, {"looks_like": "bear", "part": "legs", "where": "four thick furry legs under the body, two in front and two in back"}, {"looks_like": "beetle", "part": "legs", "where": "tiny jointed legs gripping the fur on top of the bear head around the base of the beetle head"}, {"looks_like": "bear", "part": "feet", "where": "at the ends of the four legs, broad paws with long claws"}, {"looks_like": "bear", "part": "tail", "where": "small furry stub at the rear of the body"}, {"looks_like": "beetle", "part": "shell", "where": "glossy dark brown-black carapace covering the neck, shoulders and top of head"}, {"looks_like": "beetle", "part": "plates", "where": "small segmented brown plates on the front of each lower leg and small rounded dark knobs along the sides of the neck armor"}, {"looks_like": "beetle", "part": "markings", "where": "row of seven small black oval holes along the middle of the furry side of the torso"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
